metadata.gitb:name: [eu.battery.industrial] Validate an uploaded Digital Product Passport
metadata.gitb:description: Upload a passport as JSON-LD and validate it against the "eu.battery.industrial" shapes (EU Battery — Battery Regulation 2023/1542). The passport's own @context is resolved from ref.openepcis.org, so it must reference the published contexts — the same condition a real consumer of the passport faces.

verify.desc: Validate against the eu.battery.industrial SHACL shapes

failure.default: "The passport does not conform to eu.battery.industrial. The failed step's report lists every violation."
